name: backendguard
description: Backend engineering guardrails for Codex: task-aware security/architecture/database context plus post-task compliance reporting for NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, and Prisma.

interface.shortDescription: AI backend engineering guardrails for NestJS/PostgreSQL/TypeORM/Prisma
interface.longDescription: BackendGuard detects your backend stack, schedules the most relevant security/architecture/database rules for the current task, injects them into Codex through hooks, and reports which rules were followed after the task completes.
